ctx.x: Kitty Carlisle. Well… maybe. I was kinda too busy playing, I guess, but… I guess it was a pretty well… I remember one time… oh, who was the guy that had the jazz radio show who was (laughs) really well known? I’ll think of it by tomorrow, anyway. Had a show from Birdland, I think. Anyway, and, and the guys—the, the waiters and the, the coat check—that was a family-owned place and everything. It was, it was really fun, yeah.
